events.description: Rachel Green says Rachel Green is very sorry to Phoebe Buffay and Monica Geller.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green did not intend to bring Phoebe Buffay and Monica Geller down.
Monica Geller says Rachel Green was right and Monica Geller does not have a plan.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is thanking God.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller is asking whether Phoebe Buffay has a plan.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay does not even have a plan.

Rachel Green says the delivered pizza is not what Rachel Green, Monica Geller, and Phoebe Buffay ordered and that Rachel Green, Monica Geller, and Phoebe Buffay ordered a fat-free crust with extra cheese.
Pizza Guy says Pizza Guy is asking Monica Geller, Rachel Green, and Phoebe Buffay to wait.
Pizza Guy says Rachel Green is not George Stephanopoulos.
Pizza Guy says Man 1, Pizza Guy's father, is going to kill Pizza Guy.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller is telling Pizza Guy to wait.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller is asking whether Pizza Guy said the name George Stephanopoulos.

Pizza Guy says the pizza Pizza Guy is holding is supposed to go across the street and that Pizza Guy must have given George Stephanopoulos the pizza intended for Monica Geller, Rachel Green, and Phoebe Buffay.
Monica Geller says George Stephanopoulos is a small Mediterranean man with curiously intelligent good looks.
Pizza Guy says Monica Geller's description of George Stephanopoulos sounds correct.
Monica Geller says George Stephanopoulos was wearing a stunning blue suit.
Pizza Guy says Pizza Guy is asking whether Monica Geller, Rachel Green, and Phoebe Buffay want Pizza Guy to take the incorrect pizza back.
Monica Geller says Pizza Guy is nuts.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller, Rachel Green, and Phoebe Buffay have George Stephanopoulos's pizza.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is asking who George Snuffalopagus is.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller sees pizza in George Stephanopoulos's apartment.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay wants to see the pizza Monica Geller is looking at.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is asking who Monica Geller, Rachel Green, and Phoebe Buffay are spying on.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green loves George Stephanopoulos.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay is telling Monica Geller and Rachel Green to wait.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay sees a woman in George Stephanopoulos's apartment.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller wants Phoebe Buffay to tell Monica Geller that the woman is George Stephanopoulos's mother.
Phoebe Buffay says the woman is walking across the floor and is going for the pizza in George Stephanopoulos's apartment.
Phoebe Buffay says the pizza is not for the woman.
